industry: Industrial robotics and robot automation software
summary: Företag 6 develops industrial robot control software and robotic systems designed to improve robot speed, precision and reach. The company commercializes advanced motion-control technology originating from research in robotics and automation.
target_market: Global industrial automation and robotics market
strategy_notes: Focused on expanding adoption of proprietary robot-control technology and robotic solutions that increase productivity in manufacturing and logistics environments.
technology_notes: Combines advanced control algorithms, motion planning and robotics engineering to improve robot performance, accuracy and workspace utilization.
risk_notes: Dependent on industrial automation investment cycles, customer adoption, technology differentiation and competition from established robotics and automation providers.
